## PII Detection & Anonymization Pipeline

Receives business data, detects PII via external API, anonymizes sensitive fields, logs an audit trail, and returns the cleaned payload. Uses exactly 5 Code, 2 API and 3 Wait nodes.

### All nodes (1-line each)
1. Webhook - Incoming Business Data – Receives the raw business payload via POST.
2. Code - Validate & Extract – Validates the request and extracts candidate PII fields.
3. Wait - Pre Detection – Short pause before calling the detection service.
4. HTTP Request - PII Detection API – Sends candidate fields to the external PII detection service.
5. Code - Parse Detection Results – Maps detection findings to field-level risk scores.
6. Wait - Post Detection – Pause after detection before anonymization.
7. Code - Apply Anonymization – Redacts or hashes PII according to policy rules.
8. Wait - Pre Downstream – Pause before calling the downstream/logging API.
9. HTTP Request - Downstream / Audit API – Forwards anonymized data or audit event to an external system.
10. Code - Build Audit Trail – Creates a structured audit record of what was changed.
11. Code - Finalize Response – Assembles the final anonymized payload and status.
12. Respond to Webhook – Returns the anonymized result to the caller.

## 1. Intake & Detect

Webhook - Incoming Business Data – Receives the raw business payload via POST.
Code - Validate & Extract – Validates the request and extracts candidate PII fields.
Wait - Pre Detection – Short pause before calling the detection service.
HTTP Request - PII Detection API – Sends candidate fields to the external PII detection service.

## 2. Anonymize & Downstream

Code - Parse Detection Results – Maps detection findings to field-level risk scores.
Wait - Post Detection – Pause after detection before anonymization.
Code - Apply Anonymization – Redacts or hashes PII according to policy rules.
Wait - Pre Downstream – Pause before calling the downstream/logging API.
HTTP Request - Downstream / Audit API – Forwards anonymized data or audit event to an external system.

## 3. Audit & Respond

Code - Build Audit Trail – Creates a structured audit record of what was changed.
Code - Finalize Response – Assembles the final anonymized payload and status.
Respond to Webhook – Returns the anonymized result to the caller.
